summary: A fun game where the player is stranded alone on a moon base. They must manage the base and face the challenges until rescue arrives. The game is filled with various details about a real moon outpost along with fun minigames that keep the player engaged. The player must make the right choices to survive throughout the day and make it onto the next day.
details:
Lunar Stranding is game that focuses on educating the player on moon outpost and the future of space exploration while keeping them engaged with fun games.

The player has been stranded alone in a moon outpost, they will face various problems that are faced by real astronauts. It will teach them decision making and to face consequences of their actions.

The project is meant to increase the curiousity of kids in the future of space while also giving them some idea about the real challenges of space.

Coding Language: Typescript, HTML, Python, CSS
Software: VS code, Github, Vercel

Our finds a fun way to integrate both educationa and game. We considered various factors like the target player's attention span and knowledge level, keeping the dialouges short without any hard technical terms.
